critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown further with SSE + TTS + import endpoints; consider splitting into routers (auth, corpus, editorial, ask, tts, import) as it likely exceeds 800 lines now.

/ask/stream emits SSE using only 'data:' lines with type embedded in JSON (no 'event:' names); this works but standard SSE clients using addEventListener('meta', ...) would not receive typed events. Current frontend parses JSON manually so it's fine, just noting for interop.
